Estimate treatment effects at a patient's baseline risk

Source: R/predict.R
estimate_treatment_effect.Rd

Adds each patient's baseline risk and the treatment effects of adding an androgen receptor pathway inhibitor (ARPI) to androgen deprivation therapy (ADT) at that risk.

Usage

estimate_treatment_effect(
  newdata,
  scale = c("ard", "rmst", "hr"),
  model = mhspc_model()
)

Arguments

newdata

A data frame with one row per patient and one column per input listed by model_inputs(): ecog_ps (0, 1, or 2), gleason_score (2 to 10), visceral_metastasis (0 or 1, or logical), bone_metastases (a count, or a category code "0-3", "4-6", "7-10", or "11+"), psa (ng/mL), hemoglobin (g/L), albumin (g/L), alp (U/L), and ldh (U/L). Other columns are kept unchanged.

scale

Effects to add: "ard", the difference in the probability of being alive at 4 years; "rmst", the difference in restricted mean survival time through 4 years, in months; "hr", the hazard ratio for death.

model

An mhspc_model object from mhspc_model().

Value

newdata with baseline_risk and, for each scale, the estimate in a column named after the scale (for example, ard) and its 95% confidence interval (ard_conf_low, ard_conf_high). Existing columns with these names are replaced.

Details

Positive absolute effects indicate gains with an ARPI. For baseline risks outside the range in which effects were estimated, the effect at the nearest edge of that range is returned, with a warning. Inputs are checked as in predict_risk().

Examples

patients <- example_patients[1:5, ]

# Difference in the proportion alive at 4 years with an ARPI: 0.16 means 16
# more patients alive per 100 treated
effects <- estimate_treatment_effect(patients, scale = "ard")
effects[c("patient_id", "baseline_risk", "ard", "ard_conf_low", "ard_conf_high")]
#>   patient_id baseline_risk          ard  ard_conf_low ard_conf_high
#> 1         P1     0.1963982 0.0002832789 -0.0945278628    0.09509442
#> 2         P2     0.2476209 0.0556955429  0.0009928562    0.11039823
#> 3         P3     0.6160547 0.1564764237  0.1044090043    0.20854384
#> 4         P4     0.8956950 0.1276327083  0.0643407300    0.19092469
#> 5         P5     0.8519254 0.1339398816  0.0803733946    0.18750637

# Additional months alive over 4 years, and the hazard ratio for death
effects <- estimate_treatment_effect(patients, scale = c("rmst", "hr"))
effects[c("patient_id", "rmst", "hr", "hr_conf_low", "hr_conf_high")]
#>   patient_id      rmst        hr hr_conf_low hr_conf_high
#> 1         P1 0.6177355 0.7546903   0.4189299    1.3595529
#> 2         P2 0.9992638 0.7079847   0.5042109    0.9941125
#> 3         P3 5.0448804 0.6037809   0.5201066    0.7009167
#> 4         P4 3.9459309 0.6854302   0.5295363    0.8872186
#> 5         P5 4.3633263 0.6642831   0.5388831    0.8188642
